messages.subject: ShinyUI Paths on Spark
parts:
Hi,

I apologize if this is a question that's already been asked/answered, but after a lengthy search, I found no answers. I've just set up a Shiny app on Spark that worked locally, but seemed to crash and burn on Spark. I think this has to do with the way in which sockJS interacts with paths on Spark. 

I've made a minimal example to reproduce this error here:
http://spark.rstudio.com/swang87/SOTCDataExpo/

The page renders correctly, but if you click on the link which has a path="/data-intro" as a parameter in the shinyUI() function, you'll see that the app immediately crashes. Any ideas on how to resolve this issue would be greatly appreciated!

Thanks,
Susan
